# IT System Optimization Strategy 2026

This document highlights critical tasks for the IT & Digital department related to system architecture and security:

*   Urgent optimization of encryption standards is required.
*   Database migration needs optimization for strategy 2026.
*   Encryption standards must be optimized for strategy 2026.
*   Investigation into the encryption standards update is necessary.
*   The database migration process needs to be updated for strategy 2026.
